data.name: Fayhaa
data.gender_notes: Fayhaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who brings joy and delight, or a joyful and delightful one. The name Fayhaa carries the meaning “Joy, Bliss, Delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fayhaa usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, bliss, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Allah, symbolizing His Joy and Delight that He bestows upon His servants
data.etymology: Fayhaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Bliss, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayhaa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فَيْحَاء
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث معناه: رائحة عطرة، نسيم، زهرة متفتحة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فَيْحَاء هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل فيح، والذي يعني الانتشار في الرائحة أو الانتشار في الخير. وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الجمال والرائحة العطرة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر: 'وَأَرسَلنَاْ الريحَ لَطِيفَةً تَسري بِأَعَينِنَاُ'.

in_urdu.name: فیحہ
in_urdu.meaning: رائحة خوشبو، سونگھ، پھول کھلنے کی خوشبو
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیحہ ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'فيح' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشبو یا سونگھ۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام خواتین کے لئے ایک خوبصورت اور دلکش معنی رکھتا ہے، جو رائحة عطرة یا پھول کی خوشبو کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फैहा
in_hindi.long_meaning: फैहा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है। यह नाम सुगंधित फूल या सुगंध की याद दिलाता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में महिलाओं के लिए एक आकर्षक और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है।

in_pashto.name: فیحا
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیحا د ښځو یو له هغو نومونو څخه دی چی د عربي کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او معنی یې د ګلونو بوی یا ښایسته ساه ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو ترمنځ ډیر مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Fayhaa
in_english.long_meaning: Fayhaa is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from the Arabic root 'fayḥ', which means 'to spread fragrance' or 'to bloom'. This name is associated with pleasant scents, aromatic fragrances, and blooming flowers. In Islamic tradition, Fayhaa is considered a lovely and elegant name for women, symbolizing beauty, charm, and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: Fayhaa is a beautiful and evocative name in Arabic, derived from the root letter combination "F-A-Y." Its cultural significance lies in the positive connotations associated with joy, delight, and happiness. In many Islamic traditions, the giving of names is seen as a blessing and opportunity to bestow an abundant and meaningful identity on the infant. A name as inspiring as Fayhaa is believed to bring joy to the bearer herself, as well as to him or her by others. Fayhaa is a name that can spark happiness in the moment and hope for a bright future.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic culture and faith, the name Fayhaa carries deeper spiritual meaning and significance. The source of our joy, delight, and happiness is believed to be God Almighty, and thus, the name could be considered a reminder of our ultimate source of joy. Joy and happiness are not simply the result of worldly possessions or circumstances; they are largely dependent on our inner state- our connection to God. Fayhaa's name is an invitation to seek that inner joy, contentment, and peace that can bring us closer to God and the blessings He has in store for us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Joy, Bliss, Delight" symbolizes She who brings joy and delight, or a joyful and delightful one. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fayhaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of joy, bliss, delight.
